candidates.summary: No fixture pins the IPFS rewrite on gno-button hrefs or inside the other link containers (columns, alerts, tables, footnotes); golden/ext_ipfs covers only gno-foreign and gno-frame
candidates.failure_scenario: <gno-button href="ipfs://<cid>/x" label="Open" /> is rewritten today only because ext_buttons.go:77 builds a plain ast.Link from the raw attribute at parse time; a refactor moving buttons to their own node type, or rendering href from the parsed attribute, leaves every button href a dead ipfs:// link while go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown stays green
candidates.verify_by: grep -rln 'gno-button\|gno-columns\|\[!NOTE\]\|\[^1\]\|| --- |' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/golden/ext_ipfs gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/ext_ipfs_test.go returns nothing; add renderIPFS(t, `<gno-button href="ipfs://`+testCIDv1+`/x" label="Open" />`, testGateway) expecting href="https://gw.test/ipfs/<cid>/x", and make it go red by changing ext_buttons.go:77 to a node type the transformer's switch does not match
candidates.evidence: grep exit 1, no hits. Probe at head (scratch test through renderIPFS): button -> <a href="https://gw.test/ipfs/bafy.../x" class="gno-button" rel="noopener nofollow ugc">; columns, alert, table, footnote, task list and strikethrough probes (production NewDefaultRenderConfig through RenderRealm) all rewritten too, so the gap is coverage, not behaviour

dropped.summary: hasURIParam splits only on '&', so ?a;uri=ipfs://<other> is rewritten with the uri key intact (probe confirmed the rewrite)
dropped.settled_by: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' against https://ipfs.filebase.io/ipfs/<cid>/?<q> returned '200 ' with no redirect for q='uri=ipfs://<cid0>', 'a;uri=ipfs://<cid0>' and 'a=1;uri=ipfs://<cid0>': the default gateway honours no uri redirect at all, and Go >=1.17 url.ParseQuery skips a pair whose key holds ';', so boxo gateways never see it
